name: Ubuntu Dialogue Corpus
description: The Ubuntu Dialogue Corpus is a large dataset containing nearly 1 million multi-turn dialogues with over 7 million utterances, designed for research in unstructured multi-turn dialogue systems and neural dialogue managers.
reputation: A classic and widely used benchmark for multi-turn response selection in open-domain dialogue research.
notes: Combines multi-turn property of DSTC datasets with unstructured interactions from microblogs; benchmark performance provided for next response selection.
